title: Shuffle once, then go in order
notes: With the Kruskal-style setting the trial shuffles all 13 edges once and contracts them in that order, skipping any edge whose ends are already together. Real code does it this way, with a union-find.
ops: A-B, A-C, B-C, B-D, C-D, A-D, D-E, E-F, E-G, F-G, F-H, G-H, E-H
